scope: Current working ISA workload comparison criteria; instruction assignments remain in the normative ISA references.
common: Pass full Release suite and fresh per-binary recorded input replay; preserve precise faults and MMIO commit rules.
Compare equal input/output, signedness, overflow, flags, clobbers, checked pointers and fault recovery. State any narrower contract.
Include unique shared helper code once, per-site wrappers, records/constants, stack, checks and register pressure.
Report code, data, total footprint, retirements, actual RAM/device traffic, stack and fault/IRQ opportunities separately.
No host speed claim from retirement counts. Benchmark instrumented and uninstrumented execution separately; report host/configuration and variance.
Publish every regression and unmeasured property. A deferral is a valid decision; synthetic-only savings cannot establish application benefit.

families.descriptor: Reduce measured safe shared-library install/replacement/readback cost, including self-contained records, ownership/leases and recovery wrappers. Require all-or-none validation tests before adoption.
families.context: Reduce complete twenty-word spill/reload sequences including scheduler validation, map leases and nested-fault recovery. Immutable frame authority must remain inaccessible; bound longest atomic work.
families.entry_proc: Require repeated hot structured transfers beyond existing shared control helpers; defer when diagnostics or one-time boot dominate.
families.multiply: Beat optimized current-ISA helper and constant strength reduction on ordinary signed/unsigned low-word cases. Do not substitute truncated MUL for checked scale overflow; justify wide forms independently.
families.divide_mod: Cover / and % independently, signed truncation toward zero, dividend-sign remainder, zero and MIN/-1 errors. Include decimal conversion and runtime helper costs; native arithmetic failures use cause 8.
families.inc_dec: Byte immediates already cost two bytes: require benefit beyond mnemonic aliases. Word forms must save bytes across measured loops with identical NZCV behavior.
families.post_increment: Measure byte and word loads/stores against hoisted constants and checked ADDP. Include boundary/fault-order differences and lost interrupt opportunities, rather than assuming fusion is semantically interchangeable.
families.lea_pointer: Retain checked arithmetic/object/width guards and pointer-study constraints. Require measured array/structure benefit after allocator and constant optimizations.
families.call_relative_indirect: Measure direct and trampoline calls, relocation and callee-save/stack ABI costs. Relative call must improve relocatable code; indirect CALL must beat a shared safe JS trampoline.
families.pushm_popm: Count only ABI-required live saves after leaf/liveness optimization, masks, wrappers and stack bounds. Require precise all-or-none failure and bounded atomic latency.
families.neg_sext: Compare existing subtraction and shift-based extension with explicit flag/clobber contracts; require occurrence-weighted savings in real callers.
families.memory_immediate_zero_compare: Compare hoisted/shared constants and existing TST aliases; include memory fault/MMIO rules and constant-pool bytes.
families.bswap_clz_ctz: Defer until representative workloads show demand and a useful net win over helpers.
